title: Gate VCF deployment on the Installer specification precheck
prompt:
Implement the exported Start-VcfInstallerValidatedSddcDeployment function in src/VcfInstaller.Deployment/VcfInstaller.Deployment.psm1. The runner installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer PowerCLI module version 13.5.0.25380678 and its VMware.OpenAPI dependencies as environment prerequisites; the seed does not vendor them. Use Get-VcfInstallerOperation to resolve exactly one generated CommandInfo for each exact operationId validateSddcSpec and deploySddc, then invoke those genuine bindings. Do not use a direct HTTP client, install or copy dependencies, or redefine/intercept VMware commands.

The function receives a caller-owned connected VCF Installer Server and a genuine SddcSpec model. First submit that same SddcSpec to validateSddcSpec. Fail closed unless the returned Validation has executionStatus COMPLETED and resultStatus SUCCEEDED, comparing both case-insensitively after trimming. Throw System.InvalidOperationException for FAILED, WARNING, in-progress, unknown, blank, or malformed validation results. The deploySddc operation is mutating: do not call it at all unless the precheck succeeds. Do not connect, disconnect, mutate, or dispose the caller's Server or SddcSpec. Suppress the Validation object from the success pipeline and return only the SddcTask returned by deploySddc.

Use the protected, specification-derived docs/contract.json as the local REST contract. Its provenance records immutable repository commit c3f3b52c845dd967cabbc21680e893292077d5ba and specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json in VMware's Apache-2.0 vmware/vcf-api-specs repository; no documentation page is a contract source. Invoke each SDK command with only Server and SddcSpec. In particular, do not bind deploySddc's optional skipValidations parameter: its absence must remain absence on the wire, not false, null, an empty value, or a bare query delimiter. Preserve all unset optional SddcSpec and nested model properties as omitted; do not rebuild or round-trip the model through JSON.

Run python3 -B .protected/verify.py. The protected verifier generates runtime-only SDDC IDs and tokens, creates a caller-owned genuine SDK connection, and drives rejected prechecks covering FAILED, WARNING, in-progress, unknown, blank, and malformed status results against a contract-pinned 127.0.0.1 mock. None may produce a deployment request. It then drives a successful precheck and requires exactly one deployment request. It reads the mock's flushed and fsynced request log and checks the exact operation order, raw targets, headers, JSON bodies, reuse of the same spec, required zero preservation, and omission of every unset optional field. The mock exposes only the two operationIds named by the contract. No live VMware endpoint is contacted. Everything under .protected/ and docs/, plus the module manifest, is protected. Edit only src/VcfInstaller.Deployment/VcfInstaller.Deployment.psm1.
